pages.text: It was too hot at midday. The village grew quiet. Even the chickens sat in the shade. Taro and Mumu needed to go home and rest, too.
"Let's rest, then come out and play again!" "When shall we come?" Taro pointed at the sky. "When the sun gets there!"
Taro was pointing to the top of a tall coconut tree. But a roof stood in front of it. Mumu looked at the roof's edge.
When the sun reached the treetop, Taro came into the yard. "Time to come out!"
The sun had not reached the roof's edge yet. Mumu lay in the shade, watching it. "Not for a while yet."
Taro waited on the road. His shadow slowly grew longer. "Why isn't Mumu coming out?"
Bored, Taro stepped on his own shadow. Stomp, stomp. Still, Mumu did not come.
At last, Mumu came out. "Why are you out already?" "I've been here for ages!" They both pointed at the sky.
Taro's finger pointed to the treetop. Mumu's pointed to the roof's edge. "Oh!"
They played at stepping on shadows. Mumu's legs were long, and so was their shadow. No matter how Taro jumped, he could not reach its end.
